findings.title: Concurrent history uploads publish rows against the wrong song dictionary
findings.preconditions: Authenticated owner importing their own history; no cross-account or auth bypass.
reproduction: Tab A starts part0/parts2/tracks1 dictionary A.
Tab B starts identical-size part0 with dictionary B, replacing pending generation.
findings.actual: Part1 accepted; current Hörprofil reports B with two minutes actually heard for A. Published generation mixes independent imports and replaces the prior history.
findings.expected: Each chunk proves the upload identity/generation. Stale tab A must fail without publishing or harming tab B/current history.
findings.repair_direction: Issue an unguessable or caller-provided unique upload id and bind all chunks to it, stored alongside progression; check on final publish; reject stale attempts.
findings.required_regression: Parallel imports with equal counts, different dictionaries/order, reordered blocks, cancel/restart, logout/re-sign-in, old-current survival until complete.

findings.title: Declared track count is trusted instead of the actual dictionary length
findings.preconditions: Authenticated owner importing their own history; no cross-account or auth bypass.
reproduction: Upload part0/parts2/tracks2 containing only dictionary A.
Upload part1 row index1 with valid time and120000ms.
findings.actual: Server accepts completion, importedPlays=1 but profile plays=0 because index1 has no track. Previous generation already removed.
findings.expected: Reject incomplete dictionaries/references to absent tracks before publication. Retain previous current import.
findings.repair_direction: Track actual accepted dictionary entries, exact final count and page lengths, verify row references against real count.
findings.required_regression: Short nonfinal/final dictionary pages, empty dictionary, declared count mismatch, malformed row index, restart and current generation intact.

findings.title: Accepted unsorted rows silently hide older imported history
findings.preconditions: Authenticated owner importing their own history; no cross-account or auth bypass.
reproduction: Dictionary A then row at current clock followed by row one day earlier, both valid shapes.
findings.actual: Upload accepted, coverage importedPlays=2, profile plays=0: timeline breaks on first row >= live_since and never examines later older row.
findings.expected: Reject unsorted rows within/across blocks, or sort and safely filter every row before using ordered timeline assumptions; publication must not silently lose valid older plays.
findings.repair_direction: Validate monotonic timestamp through upload progression and on publication, or remove break in favor of filter plus safe ordering.
findings.required_regression: Descending rows within/across blocks, duplicate timestamps/duplicates policy, liveSince crossing, matching coverage, previous-generation survival.

findings.title: Fall DST places a Sunday listen into a Tuesday weekly bucket
findings.preconditions: Authenticated owner importing their own history; no cross-account or auth bypass.
reproduction: Second is SundayOct25 23:30 local after DST ends.
findings.actual: Two series points: Monday2026-10-19 and Tuesday2026-10-20, rather than same Monday bucket. Subtracting6 fixed24h days crosses offset change and reaches Tuesday00:30 local.
findings.expected: Both local-calendar-week events in Monday2026-10-19 bucket with2plays.
findings.repair_direction: Compute week start from local calendar date/day index rather than subtracting UTC milliseconds then reformatting in zone.
findings.required_regression: Spring/fall DST near local midnight Europe/Berlin and other real zones, all points Monday, same-week events combine, totals preserved.
